lines.text: No job, no laptop, a car with rockets. I'm great.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: For real.

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: For real, I'm tired of being blamed. I'd like to be tired of something else.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: We'll find you something else to be tired of. Promise.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: That's Gears' place. Big door, loud sign. Knock twice.

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: Why twice?

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: Once, he thinks it's a delivery. Twice, he thinks it's me.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: Okay. Washington Square. You know about the camp?

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: Occupy JPBank. Tents and drums under the arch.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: Forty-one days. Bailouts, bonuses, foreclosures. They want an audit of the bank.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: Every night the news shows the tents, and JPBank looks worse.

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: So the bank throws a party next door.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: 'JPBank Loves New York.' Free hot dogs, a stage, and Fiona on a megaphone.

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: Who's Fiona?

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: Head of Community. Her business card has glitter on it. Real glitter.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: And three big screens on rigs on the lawn, pointed right at the tents.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: Running a reel on a loop. You, ten feet tall. 'The bad apple.'

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: Please tell me it's not the badge photo.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: It's the badge photo.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: That's the pitch. The bank isn't rotten. It had one bad apple, and it caught him.

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: And if it's one bad apple, nobody checks the orchard.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: No audit. Nobody looks at the fifty-first floor.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: The reel runs off the three rigs. The big screen under the arch just mirrors them.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: Kill the rigs, the reel dies.

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: And no reel, no bad apple.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: And no bad apple, Fiona's just a lady with a megaphone and a lot of hot dogs.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: Careful. The Suits are in the crowd. They'll start something and pin it on you.

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: So if I smash their screens at a community day, I'm the bad apple.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: You're already the bad apple. Be a fast one.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: One more thing. The camp's kitchen is run by Ms. Bea.

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: Should I know Ms. Bea?

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: She taught me seventh-grade science. She will not let you be rude.

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: I'm never rude.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: Two weeks ago you walked past the camp in a suit, and a man with a drum told you to quit your job.

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: And then I got fired. He's a prophet. I owe him a drum.

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: Why is your science teacher living in a tent?

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: JPBank took her house. Thirty years of payments, three months late.

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: Three months?

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: Her husband was sick. The bank sent a letter. Then a locksmith.

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: And now a hot dog party.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: And now a hot dog party.

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: You know the bailout paid for my training class?

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: Your what?

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: First-year training. Six weeks in a hotel ballroom. A man in a vest explaining risk.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: Did he explain it?

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: He explained it belongs to other people.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: How's Gears?

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: He made me breakfast and showed me a scar from a thruster.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: A big scar?

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: He said it's a small scar on a big man.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: That's the arch. Park on Fifth and walk in.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: I'll be watching the broadcast. Be quick.

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: I'm always quick.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: You're always late.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: Two of their cars on you. The Village is all crooked streets. Use them.

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: Gears said the thrusters were very safe.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: Gears says that about everything.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: Break their line. Corners, Dan. Corners.

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: I'm cornering!

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: Corner harder.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: Hop the traffic if you have to.

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: Hopping!

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: Did you just jump a taxi?

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: Very safe. Mostly.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: Bea's people are filming you from the park.

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: Tell them to get my good side.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: You're in a car.

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: The car is my good side.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: They're gone. You lost them.

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: I lost them.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: Don't sound so surprised.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: On foot? Dan, they have cars! Get back in!

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: Go, go!

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: They've got you again. Turn!

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: Still on you. Next corner!

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: They lost you. Keep it that way.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: Out of sight. Keep going.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: Okay. Breathe. You're clear.

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: Breathing. Did it work?

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: The reel died mid-sentence. 'The face of insider trad—' and then black.

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: Good.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: Better than good. The camp filmed the whole thing. Forty phones.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: Bank security jumping the bank's own bad apple, at a free hot dog party.

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: When you put it like that, I sound innocent.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: You are innocent. Now it looks like it.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: Bea got on the people's mic. The whole park was chanting 'Free Dan.'

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: I've never had a chant.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: And she crossed out 'greedy' on that sign. Now it says 'Dan, Dan, the fall man.'

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: That's... actually accurate.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: If the camp gets its audit, the insiders go down with Mr. Big. They're panicking. At him, for once.

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: That's why he moved the laptop up to dawn.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: And Rook's driving it. The one who wants out.

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: Either he wants out, or Mr. Big wants me alone in a dark park.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: So we're careful.

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: We're never careful.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: We start tonight. Go back to Gears. Eat something. Sleep an hour.

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: Yes, Ms. Bea.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: Don't. She'd like you, by the way. She says you have a polite face.

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: Tell her it's the only one I've got.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: Moon watched the whole thing on my laptop.

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: Was she proud?

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: She barked at Fiona and slept through the chase.

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: Priorities.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: Your mom saw it on the news.

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: Which part?

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: The chanting. She called the station to say you're a very polite boy.

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: Did they put her on?

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: They put her on. Twice.

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: How many people are we talking? Chanting.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: The park. And eleven thousand people watching JPBank's own broadcast.

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: JPBank broadcast me getting jumped by JPBank.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: Live. They paid for it, too.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: There's the garage. Go. Sleep.

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: Love you.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: Love you. Go.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: You're going to see Rook.

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: He said come alone.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: He said. I didn't. I'm on the phone. That's alone-ish.

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: Alone-ish.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: If anything feels off, you drive away. Promise me.

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: Promise.

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: What do you think Rook wants?

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: Out. Like he said.

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: Everybody wants out of something.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: I don't. I like my couch.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: Moon's asleep on your hoodie again.

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: Tell her I'm coming home soon.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: She knows. She's keeping it warm.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: No Rook yet.

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: He'll come.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: Then we wait. Together. Ish.
